meta.question: smallest second-traverse sensor height at which all three flows recover to within 5 deg, and separately 10 deg, with everything but z held fixed
meta.noise_model: i.i.d. zero-mean Gaussian sigma_B = 0.50 nT per axis per station; ONE matched low-traverse noise matrix reused at every height, per-height matrix for the upper traverse

scenario.held_fixed: standoff y = -1 m, x extent, 1 cm spacing and path length are identical for both traverses at every height; only z changes

inversion.iterative: ProjectedGNCG({'maxIter': 20, 'maxIterCG': 20, 'tolCG': 0.0001}) + Smallness(zero reference) + BetaEstimate_ByEig(beta0_ratio=0.0001) + UpdatePreconditioner + TargetMisfit(chifact=1.0); verified identical to inversion_helpers.iterative_recover_M_ref
inversion.phi_d_convention: simpeg L2DataMisfit returns sum((r/sigma)^2) = chi^2 (no 0.5 prefactor); target = nD, NOT 0.5*nD; normalized residual rms = sqrt(phi_d/nD)

meta.threshold_definition: a height 'recovers all three flows' when the MAXIMUM over the three flows of the ensemble-MEAN direction error is at or below the threshold

z12.5_anchor_comparison.note: reference is the three_layer_wall.py pair (N = 1000, its own seeds); this run uses N = 500 and different seeds, so agreement is to Monte-Carlo error
